g.text: Study A | The 230-seat event at a common 60-second search allowance

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle

g.text: 99 Emperor registrations (198 seats), 19 Merit and 13 Bodhi; 131 registration units; current preference order

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #434a54

g.text: Identical controlled settings: one worker; no canonicalization; fresh 60-second searches. CP-SAT remained feasible without proof; SCIP proved the minimum. Greedy

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #434a54

g.text: returned no map. Registration numbers identify placements, not preference quality.
